clippings.speaker: Paul Thomas Anderson
clippings.quote: I found this actor who I just think can do anything. And I - he's capable of so much that you can throw anything at him.
clippings.title: The Fresh Air Interview: Paul Thomas Anderson, The Man Behind 'The Master'
clippings.context: Said to Terry Gross on Fresh Air about casting Hoffman as the cult leader Lancaster Dodd; date taken from the NPR article URL.

clippings.speaker: Philip Seymour Hoffman
clippings.quote: The good thing is that when he writes for me there is a certain knowledge he has of who I am that he’s trying to put there.
clippings.title: Interview: BAM Q&A
clippings.context: Answering a question about the pair's working relationship at a BAM Q&A, on how writing parts for him works; event date not on the page.

clippings.speaker: Philip Seymour Hoffman
clippings.quote: And Paul was really helpful the whole way through. He was cautious at first when I brought in what I did, and then we just nurtured it together.
clippings.title: Actor Philip Hoffman
clippings.context: Said to Terry Gross on Fresh Air about building the voice and character of Scotty; the interview first aired Nov. 30, 1999 and was rebroadcast Oct. 11, 2002.

notes: Three quotes each way; the BAM Q&A transcript (cigsandredvines.blogspot.com) supplied four, Fresh Air 1999 and NPR 2012 the rest. The BAM event date isn't on the page, so the date is the transcript post date. Esquire 'incomparable' quote appeared only in search snippets, not fetched, so left out.
